value.rationale: The claim completely classifies the smallest nontrivial positive-alphabet instance of an explicit 2026 question about when expected marginal random-target mixing times are history-independent. The two nonnegative square factorizations quantify the otherwise hidden memory dependence and show that a balanced stationary marginal can coexist with large history-sensitive gaps. This is a structural rigidity result, not only an instance of computing a textbook first-order Kemeny constant.
